themes.label: Core Inflation Trajectory - December Hike Locked; 2027 Path Now the Question
themes.stance: October core CPI came in at exactly 0.30% MoM, tripping the hawkish tell. December hike is now locked: markets price 84% odds of 4.25% upper bound at year-end, 10.5% on 4.5% or higher. 2Y rose to 4.56% (89th percentile of 10 years), pricing roughly 1-2 more hikes into 2027. 3-month annualized core running ~3.7%, YTD headline ~4.5% annualized. Theme inflects: the December hike is no longer an edge — the question shifts to whether 2027 hikes get priced. Labor tight (unemployment 4.1%, 3-month payroll avg 137k), China PPI +5.7% YoY both argue core stays sticky. Curve bear-flattened 7bp on Nov 10 to 25bp (10Y-2Y). Memo adds IEF if 10Y reaches 5.00%+; avoids ZROZ.
themes.tell: Dec 4 November payrolls: unemployment 4.4%+ = December hike off, theme collapses. Dec 10 November CPI core ≤0.20% = trim STIP, 2027 hike path reprices lower. Dec 15-16 FOMC dots: 2027 median dot above 4.50% = confirms extended tightening cycle. Core above 0.30% again = front-end pressure continues.

themes.label: Breakeven / TIPS Mispricing - 5Y Breakeven 2.25%; Gap to Core Widening
themes.stance: 5Y breakeven fell further to 2.25% (from 2.29%) on Oct CPI day, even as core printed 0.30% MoM. Breakeven now sits ~0.6pt below core YoY (2.87%) and ~1.5pt below the 3-month annualized pace of 3.7%. Memo reads breakevens as following oil lower (WTI ~$100 from ~$110) and Fed credibility, not core. China PPI +5.7% YoY (prior read) argues cheap-goods tailwind for US core is reversing. Hold STIP; avoid long TIPS (TIPZ) and long zeros (ZROZ). Trim STIP only on Dec 10 core CPI ≤0.20%.
themes.tell: Dec 10 November CPI core ≤0.20% = trim STIP. Core goods firming in Nov/Dec CPI = confirms China PPI pass-through. 5Y breakeven recovering above 2.46% with oil above $100 = consider adding. Rising real yields (IEF trade activating near 5.00% 10Y) = headwind for IAU.

themes.label: Equity-Rate Reconciliation - HY Retreated to 3.34%; Trigger Missed
themes.stance: HY spreads eased to 3.34% in the two sessions before CPI (from 3.48%), missing the 3.50% trigger. Still wide at the 83rd percentile of the past 3 years, after a +64bp move over three months. No beta cut, no HYG puts triggered. Credit's response to the CPI-driven December hike repricing is not yet in the data. Concentration risk remains: NVDA reports Nov 18 and Anthropic reportedly begins trading Nov 19. SPY puts held through Nov 18; extend only once Anthropic first-trade date is confirmed. Close puts early if HY drops below 3.30%.
themes.tell: HY daily close ≥3.50% = execute beta cut, add HYG puts. HY falling below 3.30% = close SPY puts early, refutes stress thesis. NVDA Nov 18 miss + HY widening together = multiples have no floor. Dec 16 FOMC: if hike delivered and HY holds wide, credit stress thesis confirmed.

themes.label: AI Trade Bifurcating - NVDA Nov 18 Binary; Governance + Oversight Overhang
themes.stance: NVDA bounced 4% after the Chinese spy/Jensen Huang report, but governance overhang persists: Democratic House oversight on China chip shipments is a 2027 drag separate from the Nov 18 print. Government stake odds at 6.5% (well below the 25% re-short tell). Apple holds 73% odds of largest company at year-end vs 23% for NVDA. No NVDA short into Nov 18 — binary event. Within hyperscaler underweight, prefer AMZN and GOOGL (Anthropic stakes get marked up) over MSFT and META. Dec 15 Apple analyst meeting tests Apple's premium.
themes.tell: NVDA Nov 18 earnings citing power or permit as bottleneck = size up EQIX/DLR, confirms data-center landlord trade. Government stake odds rising above 25% or concrete House oversight action = re-establish NVDA short. Apple odds fall below 50% largest-company = reassess Apple premium. AAPL Dec 15 analyst day guidance disappoints = pair re-opens.

themes.label: Anthropic IPO - Share Supply Tell Tripped; Nov 19 First-Trade Date Reported
themes.stance: Anthropic set an IPO price range of $70-78 and reportedly plans to begin trading Nov 19. Markets now price 98% odds of a $600B+ day-one market cap (up from 97.5%). The share-supply tell has tripped: fund rotation out of existing AI megacaps around first-trade date is the operative risk. SPY put hedge extended only once first-trade date is confirmed. AMZN and GOOGL preferred within hyperscaler underweight (Anthropic stakes get valuation mark-up); MSFT OpenAI stake stays illiquid (OpenAI 2026 IPO at 1.55% odds). Size modestly — this is largely known by the market.
themes.tell: Nov 19 Anthropic first trade confirmed = supply drag on AI megacaps activates; monitor NVDA/MSFT/META relative underperformance. AMZN/GOOGL guidance citing Anthropic stake mark-up = confirms valuation thesis. OpenAI IPO odds rising above 10% = reassess MSFT illiquidity discount. Anthropic day-one cap below $400B = supply drag thesis overshoots, reassess.

themes.label: State Permitting / Power Politics - CoreWeave Beat Stresses Short Leg; NVDA Nov 18 Decides
themes.stance: CoreWeave beat and raised guidance (+15%), hurting the short CRWV/IREN leg of the EQIX/DLR long vs CRWV/IREN short pair. However, WSJ flagged CoreWeave's capital workaround works 'for now,' keeping the funding-squeeze thesis alive. Higher rates structurally disadvantage leveraged AI cloud operators. Divided government (Democratic House) means federal ban cannot pass; real risk channels remain state permitting, utility rate cases, and congressional oversight — all slow new builds and raise scarcity value of powered capacity. Hold long EQIX/DLR vs short CRWV/IREN. Close pair if NVDA Nov 18 does not cite power or site limits as a bottleneck.
themes.tell: NVDA Nov 18 earnings citing power or site limits = size up EQIX/DLR. Texas or other state bill language on data-center moratorium = confirms thesis. NVDA Nov 18 does not cite power/site constraints = close the pair. CoreWeave refinancing stress emerging = short leg recovers.

themes.label: Gulf Escalation / Oil Impulse - Iran Invasion Odds Fell to 7.5%; Theme Fading
themes.stance: US invasion odds fell to 7.5% from 11.5% as Netanyahu's exit odds reached 52.5% and Iran activity remains at proxy level (US charged three Iran-backed men with plotting attacks including on UK base RAF Fairford). WTI near $100. Hold core XLE, VLO, MPC; do not add. Trim to core sleeve only on a signed deal with WTI sustaining below $90. OPEC+ meets Nov 30. Ukrainian refinery strikes on Russia remain a live secondary supply risk.
themes.tell: Signed Iran deal with WTI sustaining below $90 = trim energy to core sleeve. Confirmed strike or collapsed talks = press energy, cut duration. OPEC+ Nov 30 cut announcement pushing WTI above $110 = re-engage energy overweight. Crack spreads widening on Russian refinery outages = add refiners.

themes.label: Divided Government - Tax Cuts Dead; Lame-Duck Brinkmanship into Dec 20
themes.stance: Midterms flipped the House to Democrats, creating divided government from January. Corporate tax cut odds are 5.5%, capital-gains cut 9% — fiscal expansion is off the table. Democrats vow continued Hegseth oversight and NVDA China-shipment investigations. Curve bear-flattened 7bp on Nov 10 to 25bp (10Y-2Y); divided government caps new fiscal supply, a possible longer-run support for the long end while the Fed weighs on the front. Near-term flashpoint: Dec 20 government funding deadline in the lame-duck session. Base case is a short stopgap into January; a shutdown would delay December data and blur the Fed's read.
themes.tell: Dec 20 government shutdown materializing = delay in December data releases, brief Treasury rally. House Democrats launching formal NVDA China-shipment investigation = re-evaluate NVDA short. Any bipartisan tax deal re-emerging = revise fiscal-supply-cap thesis. Short stopgap passed cleanly = removes tail risk, theme fades.

dropped.reason: resolved: memo closes FXE at discretion; EUR/USD-to-1.10 odds at 41.5% and Fed/ECB divergence no longer support the squeeze case
